Task.Title: Open two pages in tabs and bookmark one in Edge
Task.Body:
Start Edge with an isolated profile by running this command:

    "{{.EdgePath}}" --user-data-dir="{{.ScratchDir}}\edge-profile" --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --window-size=1200,900 "{{.BaseURL}}/page-a.html"

If a welcome or sign-in page appears, dismiss it; no sign-in is needed.

Then:

1. In a new tab, open {{.BaseURL}}/page-b.html (type the address in the
   address bar).
2. Bookmark the page in that tab, naming the bookmark "Field guide".

Close the browser when you are done (closing flushes the profile's
bookmarks).

results.Reason: requires Microsoft Edge (msedge.exe was not found)

Task.Title: Change the download setting and save a download in a specific folder
Task.Body:
Start Edge with an isolated profile by running this command:

    "{{.EdgePath}}" --user-data-dir="{{.ScratchDir}}\edge-profile" --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --window-size=1200,900 about:blank

If a welcome or sign-in page appears, dismiss it; no sign-in is needed.

Then:

1. In the address bar, go to edge://settings/downloads and turn on "Ask
   where to save each file before downloading".
2. Open {{.BaseURL}}/download.html and download the report file linked
   there. In the save dialog, save it as
   "{{.ScratchDir}}\report.bin".

Close the browser when you are done.

Task.Title: Fill and submit a web form in Edge
Task.Body:
Start Edge with an isolated profile by running this command:

    "{{.EdgePath}}" --user-data-dir="{{.ScratchDir}}\edge-profile" --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --window-size=1200,900 "{{.BaseURL}}/form.html"

If a welcome or sign-in page appears, dismiss or navigate past it; no
sign-in is needed. The browser should show a "Team registration" form.

Fill the form with exactly these values:

- Full name: Marina Ionescu
- Email: marina.ionescu@example.org
- Team: Cascade
- Role: Operations
- Send me the newsletter: checked
- Notes: I can bring a spare keyboard to the meetup.

Then click Register. The page should confirm your registration. Close
the browser when you are done.

Task.Title: Organize an invoice folder in File Explorer
Task.Body:
Open File Explorer showing the folder "{{.ScratchDir}}\Invoices" (for
example by running: explorer "{{.ScratchDir}}\Invoices").

In that folder:

1. Create a new folder named "2024".
2. Move all six invoice files (invoice-2024-01.txt through
   invoice-2024-06.txt) into the 2024 folder.
3. Rename draft-summary.txt to summary.txt.
4. Leave notes.txt where it is.

Close the Explorer window when you are done. Everything must stay inside
the Invoices folder, and the files' contents must not change.

Task.Title: Create a ZIP archive of the report files
Task.Body:
Open File Explorer showing the folder "{{.ScratchDir}}\Reports" (for
example by running: explorer "{{.ScratchDir}}\Reports").

Select the three .txt files in the folder and create a ZIP archive from
the selection (right-click > "Compress to ZIP file", or the equivalent
the system offers). Name the archive "reports.zip" (rename it if the
system gives it a different name) and leave it inside the Reports
folder.

Close the Explorer window when you are done. The three original files
must remain in the folder.

Task.Title: Type a note in Notepad and save it through the Save As dialog
Task.Body:
Open Notepad and type this note exactly:

Museum visit notes

The natural history museum opens at 9:30 on weekdays.
The planetarium show costs 12 euros and runs at 11:00 and 14:00.
Remember: no flash photography in the gem hall.

Todo after the visit: buy the guidebook and email Anna the photos.

Save the note as "museum-notes.txt" inside "{{.ScratchDir}}" using
Notepad's Save As dialog, then close Notepad.

Task.Title: Open a file in Notepad and replace every DRAFT marker
Task.Body:
Open the file "{{.ScratchDir}}\project-log.txt" in Notepad (use Notepad's
Open dialog).

Use Notepad's Replace feature to replace every occurrence of "DRAFT"
with "FINAL". Save the file, then close Notepad.

Task.Title: Draw a line on the Paint canvas and save the drawing
Task.Body:
Open Paint (mspaint). Select the Pencil tool and draw one continuous
line across the canvas, starting near the top-left corner and ending
near the bottom-right corner.

Save the drawing as "line.png" inside "{{.ScratchDir}}" (a PNG image),
then close Paint.

Task.Title: Draw a rectangle in Paint and save the drawing
Task.Body:
Open Paint (mspaint). Using the rectangle shape tool, draw a rectangle
roughly a quarter of the canvas in size, in the middle of the canvas.

Save the drawing as "rect.png" inside "{{.ScratchDir}}" (a PNG image),
then close Paint.

Task.Title: Create a file in VS Code and save it
Task.Body:
Start VS Code opening the project folder by running this command:

    code "{{.ScratchDir}}\project"

If VS Code asks whether you trust the authors of this folder, choose the
option that lets you work with it. If a welcome page or tour opens,
close it.

In the project folder, create a new file named "checklist.md"
containing exactly:

Setup checklist

- confirm the display cable is seated
- label the two spare SSDs
- update the meeting room calendar

Save the file, then close VS Code.
